Talkville App — Practice Small Talk & Social Skills with AI (iOS)

Get Talkville

## One download. Unlimited practice reps.

No accounts to set up before you start, no group workshop to sign up for — just open the app and pick a scenario.

- ✅ Free to download, in-app purchases unlock unlimited scenarios
- ✅ Requires iOS 17.0 or later — built for iPhone
- ✅ New situations added regularly (walk the whole town, talk to anyone)

Inside the app

## A cozy town built for social practice

Every building is a different situation. Walk in, talk to the AI character, and get feedback in real time.

#### The Town Map

Fries shop, hairdresser, bar, church and more — pick the situation you actually struggle with.

#### Meet the Characters

Every AI character has a different personality, so no two conversations play out the same way.

How it works

## Three steps to feeling ready

Low pressure. No one watching. Built for anxious, rusty, or avoidant-leaning conversationalists.

1

### Choose a situation

Pick the exact scenario that makes you freeze — small talk, a first date, a job interview, a networking event, an awkward silence.

2

### Roleplay with an AI character

Have the real conversation with an AI character who has their own personality and context. Say the wrong thing — nothing's at stake.

3

### Get feedback, then do it again

Instant AI feedback on your communication style and common mistakes. Repeat the scenario as many times as you need until it feels natural.

Small talk Flirting & dating Public speaking Confidence & charisma Negotiation & persuasion Active listening Awkward silences Ending conversations Job interviews Networking

FAQ

## Questions people ask before they download

### How do I get better at making small talk?

Rehearse specific everyday situations until the opening lines feel automatic. Talkville lets you roleplay those exact situations with AI characters first.

### What's the best app for social anxiety?

Look for one that lets you rehearse full conversations privately, not just read tips. That's exactly what Talkville is built for.

### Can I practice conversations with AI before doing them in real life?

Yes. Pick a real-life situation, roleplay it with an AI character, get instant feedback, and try again until it feels natural.

### How do I practice small talk before a first date?

Rehearse the first five minutes — greetings, a couple of open-ended questions, a graceful way to keep it moving — in Talkville's dating scenarios.

### How do I stop awkward silences in a conversation?

Practicing a scenario in advance builds a mental library of natural follow-ups, so silences turn into pauses instead of dead ends.

### How do I get over my fear of talking to strangers?

Small, safe doses of exposure work best. Talk to AI "strangers" in Talkville's town first, with zero real-world risk.

### How can I practice job interview conversations?

Roleplay the full back-and-forth with an AI character and get feedback on your communication style — not just prepared answers.

### How do I build confidence talking to people?

Repeat the same social situation as many times as you need, in a low-pressure setting, until it stops feeling like a performance.

### How can I practice flirting or dating conversations?

Talkville's dating scenarios let you roleplay with an AI character and get feedback on tone and pacing before a real date.

### Is Talkville iPhone only?

Yes — Talkville currently requires iOS 17.0 or later and is built for iPhone.

Get it on the App Store →

### Are the characters in Talkville real people?

No — they're AI characters with different personalities and contexts, so you can practice specific scenarios without any real-world pressure.

## Ready to practice small talk without anxiety?

Download Talkville on your iPhone and try your first scenario today — free to start.
